[[File:Field_Commander.jpg|thumb|Imperial and Rebel Field Commanders.]]
Pivotal to any ground campaign, '''field commanders''' improved the morale and tactical abilities of all ground units under their command. The rank was also used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[warrior caste]].

Culled from the best recruits in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], field commanders were trained at one of the Imperial military academies located throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. They were often only lightly [[Armor/Legends|armored]], with a helmet and vest for protection.

==History==
One [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] field commander was sent in to [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] to find the rogue [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]]. Due to the officer's incompetence at ensuring a stealthy landing, however, Kalast escaped. As punishment for his failure, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed the commander.

At least seventeen more Imperial commanders were present during the [[Skirmish on Carida|demonstration]] of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. As a result of an invasion by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces, the commanders engaged in combat.

Another was in charge of the defense of a [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas refinery during a raid. Due to his failure to defeat the invaders, however, he was executed by Darth Vader.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', field commanders increase the health and sight range of all nearby units. This could be explained as the presence of the commander increasing morale.
